purpose: Define deterministic authority resolution among definition, reconciliation, generated, migration, history and other declared source roles without using file freshness, path order or archive order as semantic precedence.

topics.name: Source Authority Precedence
topics.purpose: Define deterministic authority resolution among definition, reconciliation, generated, migration, history and other declared source roles without using file freshness, path order or archive order as semantic precedence.

semantics.authority_rule: Semantic authority is determined by explicit source role, accepted snapshot/release state and reconciliation outcome.
semantics.freshness_rule: mtime, upload time and commit recency are advisory provenance only and never semantic precedence by themselves.
semantics.path_rule: Directory depth/name/alphabetical order never establishes authority.
semantics.archive_rule: ZIP member order never establishes authority.
semantics.reconciliation_rule: Conflicting same-identity sources require explicit reconciliation/supersession rather than implicit winner selection.
semantics.history_rule: Historical/deprecated/superseded artifacts remain traceable but cannot override active accepted definitions.
semantics.candidate_rule: Candidate/review sources cannot override accepted definitions until explicit approval/replacement.

invariants.rule: Canonical source resolution is deterministic, exact-identity based and provenance-preserving; filesystem location, transport or freshness never silently changes semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: candidate source overrides accepted source automatically
same-identity conflict resolved without reconciliation evidence

references.purpose: Accepted/released snapshot state participates in authority resolution.
